name: CRS Status 1 Code
definition: Specifies the Common Reporting Status (CRS) status.

C101.name: CRS 101
C101.definition: Account holder type is a passive non-financial entity with one or more controlling persons that are foreign persons.

C102.name: CRS 102
C102.definition: Account holder type is a foreign person.

C103.name: CRS 103
C103.definition: Account holder type is a passive foreign non-financial entity without controlling persons that are foreign persons.

C104.name: CRS 104
C104.definition: Account holder type is a financial institution such as a depositary, a custodial institution or a specified insurance company.

C105.name: CRS 105
C105.definition: Account holder type is a financial institution such as an investment entity of a non-participating jurisdiction and managed by another financial institution without one or more controlling persons that are foreign persons.

C106.name: CRS 106
C106.definition: Account holder type is a financial institution such as an investment entity of a non-participating jurisdiction and managed by another financial institution with one or more controlling persons that are foreign persons.

C107.name: CRS 107
C107.definition: Account holder type is a financial institution such as another investment entity.

C108.name: CRS 108
C108.definition: Account holder type is an active non-financial entity such as a corporation for which the stock is regularly traded on an established securities market.

C109.name: CRS 109
C109.definition: Account holder type is an active non-financial entity such as a corporation which is a related entity of a corporation for which the stock is regularly traded on an established securities market.

C110.name: CRS 110
C110.definition: Account holder type is an active non-financial entity such as a government entity.

C111.name: CRS 111
C111.definition: Account holder type is an active non-financial entity such as a central bank.

C112.name: CRS 112
C112.definition: Account holder type is an active non-financial entity such as an international organisation.

C113.name: CRS 113
C113.definition: Account holder type is not a foreign person.

C114.name: CRS 114
C114.definition: Account holder type is a financial institution such as an investment entity of a participating jurisdiction and managed by another financial institution.
